author_role: collision_code design worker; final implementation reassigned by root to named lower-tier worker
scope: Instantaneous fixed-selected-edge photon/target collision consumer, source parameters and reference-normalization Jacobian; no IVP or continuum convergence claim

source_fixture.normalization_rule: Use saved continuous normalizers, not renormalization of the coarse packet rule
source_fixture.photon_fixture: N_j = 1 s times sum_s S_sj; explicitly local unit-exposure operator fixture, not a cosmic photon history
source_fixture.packet_energy_drift: Main check fixed E. Optional supplied E_dot tests only the explicit work term; no anisotropic transport reconstruction
source_fixture.finite_rule_accuracy_claim: None. The known difference from continuous source normalization is reported, not hidden or calibrated away

selected_registry.upstream_owner: WU generic event compiler; this unit is a consumer only
selected_registry.extraction: Static ast.literal_eval of exact tuple assignments or a byte-pinned name-keyed registry; do not import the SciPy-dependent old module merely for constants
selected_registry.LiI_scope: Pinned PH2 ground valence below 64.39 eV; original PH1 2s partial above. No core/Auger closure

normalization_scope.density: Independent positive external input. Density sensitivity holds normalized state and per-reference source templates fixed
normalization_scope.gradient: Optional supplied gradient of Lambda at fixed nref; residual used for derivative checks must recompute the same affine Lambda(z)
normalization_scope.excluded: No automatic state-dependent nref closure, implicit coordinate map, or volume-source density chain rule

design_gates_for_contract_review.scaling: Positive coordinate scales from the frozen positive fixture, row scales sum_j abs(J_ij)*coordinate_scale_j. Zero rows checked separately. Report photon-target, target-photon, target-target and energy rows separately; never use max(1,abs(J))
design_gates_for_contract_review.photon_target_FD_conditioning: Use injection off, Lambda=0 for collision FD. Keep N nonzero: source-off does not mean zero residual. Separately check source columns and q-on complex step

planned_checks: finite packet source normalization matches saved legacy GL2 ratios
actual provider values and domain, including LiI branch and Mb-to-m2 conversion
vectorized residual against independent scalar event loop
collision Jacobian centered FD, all block scales reported
q-on complex-step Jacobian, all block scales reported
density partial at fixed normalized state and per-reference source templates
affine-Lambda Jacobian recomputing Lambda in perturbed residual
eight isotope totals with normalization term
charge/electron production and photon-number/electron combined identity
single-owner total energy including Xext and optional supplied E_dot work
reference-density rescaling equivalence in proper densities
source-off with photons retained and dark state with source on
zero-state boundary positivity, no full-Jacobian Metzler claim
no-neutron collision row and selected isotope trace-channel coverage
invalid domains rejected without silent clipping

execution.requires: Astra frozen contract, independent static review, root byte-bound GO
